page.overview:
What is Oinkologne?

Oinkologne's form are different depending on the gender, though both are fat, quadrupedal pig-like Pokémon. Male Oinkolonge have a black upper body and light black lower body (also applying on the ears), a larger left ear, pink eyelids, feet, nose, a bulb-like tail tip and thin yellow lower eyelids. Female Oinkolonge have a light brown upper body and dark brown lower body, a larger right ear, brown eyelids, feet, nose, a broom-like tail tip and thick yellow lower eyelids.

Shiny Oinkologne, regardless of the gender, have a light white upper body and pink lower body, almost resembling real-life pigs.

Regardless of their gender, Oinkologne are meticulous Pokémon that likes to keep everything tidy. Male Oinkologne are proud of their fine, glossy skin, while female Oinkologne can entrance other female Pokémon with its sweet, alluring scent.

An Oinkologne emits a floral aroma from its body, which can soothe Pokémon around it, which can even override opposing Pokémon's abilities. This scent can also cause other Pokémon to fall in love with it.
